hero.title: Empire Restaurant: Bangalore's Culinary Legacy, Exquisite Tastes Await
hero.subtitle: Experience decades of authentic flavors and cherished dining traditions since 1966.

about.title: Our Enduring Legacy of Flavor
about.paragraph1: Since 1966, Empire Restaurant has been a cornerstone of Bangalore's culinary scene, an iconic establishment built on a foundation of exceptional taste and unparalleled hospitality. We pride ourselves on creating memorable dining experiences that blend timeless recipes with a passion for quality.
about.paragraph2: For over five decades, we have dedicated ourselves to perfecting signature dishes like our renowned Bucket Biriyani and rich Haleem, alongside a diverse menu that celebrates the vibrant tapestry of Indian cuisine. Join us and become part of our storied tradition, where every meal tells a tale.
